name.text: Finding an Angle with the Sine Rule

questiontext.text:
Consider triangle \(ABC\), where:

  • \(A={@A@}^\circ\)
  • \(a=BC={@side_a@}\text{ cm}\)
  • \(b=AC={@side_b@}\text{ cm}\)

The diagram below illustrates the triangle.

[[jsxgraph]] /* Retrieve the randomised STACK variables */ var Adeg = {#A#}; var a = {#side_a#}; var b = {#side_b#}; var c = {#side_c#}; /* Convert angle A to radians */ var Arad = Adeg * Math.PI / 180; /* Coordinates of the triangle */ var Ax = 0; var Ay = 0; var Cx = b; var Cy = 0; var Bx = c * Math.cos(Arad); var By = c * Math.sin(Arad); /* Calculate suitable diagram boundaries */ var xmin = Math.min(Ax,Bx,Cx)-2; var xmax = Math.max(Ax,Bx,Cx)+3; var ymin = Math.min(Ay,By,Cy)-2; var ymax = Math.max(Ay,By,Cy)+3; /* Initialise the board */ var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [xmin,ymax,xmax,ymin], axis: false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false, keepaspectratio: true }); /* Create the triangle vertices */ var pA = board.create('point',[Ax,Ay], { name: 'A', fixed: true, size: 3, color: 'black' }); var pB = board.create('point',[Bx,By], { name: 'B', fixed: true, size: 3, color: 'black' }); var pC = board.create('point',[Cx,Cy], { name: 'C', fixed: true, size: 3, color: 'black' }); /* Draw the three sides */ board.create('segment',[pA,pB], { strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 2 }); board.create('segment',[pB,pC], { strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 2 }); board.create('segment',[pC,pA], { strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 2 }); /* Mark the known angle A */ board.create('angle',[pC,pA,pB], { radius: 0.8, fillColor: '#60a5fa', fillOpacity: 0.3, strokeColor: '#2563eb', name: 'A = '+Adeg+'°', withLabel: true }); /* Mark the unknown angle B */ board.create('angle',[pA,pB,pC], { radius: 0.8, fillColor: '#fbbf24', fillOpacity: 0.3, strokeColor: '#d97706', name: 'B = ?', withLabel: true }); /* Label side a */ board.create('text',[ function(){return (Bx+Cx)/2+0.3;}, function(){return (By+Cy)/2+0.5;}, 'a = '+a+' cm' ], { fontSize: 14, fixed: true }); /* Label side b */ board.create('text',[ b/2, -0.9, 'b = '+b+' cm' ], { fontSize: 14, fixed: true }); board.update(); [[/jsxgraph]]

Calculate the size of angle \(B\) using the Sine Rule.

Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.

[[input:ans1]]

[[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

We are given:

  • \(A={@A@}^\circ\)
  • \(a={@side_a@}\text{ cm}\)
  • \(b={@side_b@}\text{ cm}\)

We need to calculate angle \(B\).

Step 1: Recall the Sine Rule.

The Sine Rule states that:

\(\dfrac{a}{\sin A}=\dfrac{b}{\sin B}\)

Step 2: Rearrange the formula.

Making \(\sin B\) the subject gives:

\(\sin B=\dfrac{b\sin A}{a}\)

Step 3: Substitute the known values.

\(\sin B=\dfrac{{@side_b@}\times\sin{@A@}^\circ}{@side_a@}\)

Therefore:

\(\sin B\approx {@sin_B@}\)

Step 4: Calculate angle B.

Take the inverse sine of both sides:

\(B=\sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{{@side_b@}\times\sin{@A@}^\circ}{@side_a@}\right)\)

Hence:

\(B\approx {@ta1@}^\circ\)

Final Answer:

\(\boxed{B={@ta1@}^\circ}\)

Remember to use degree mode on your calculator and round your answer to 1 decimal place.
